snippet.title: Orbis | Throw Them All!
snippet.description:
Orbis is an amusing casual game with astonishing art and design that challenges your reaction time, memory and eyes! You need an alarm to help you to stop playing!

You must throw disks of the tower to the blue or red side based on their colors and do not let the tower reach the top! but it might not be simple after all.

Features:
- Rich and entertaining gameplay with 4 main game modes: Normal, Classic, Mad and Invisible (more still coming!).
- Exciting original music which dynamically changes with the rhythm of the game.
- Beautiful and stunning art.
- Rewards to upgrading different features in the game.

For Download from Goole Play Store:
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MadnessGames.Orbis
